blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines —A Taiwanese national accused of leading a Manila-based fraud syndicate has been arrested by immigration authorities in Cebu City. In a statement issued on Saturday, the Bureau of Immigration (BI) said that Yu Sheng Fu, 27, who allegedly led the swindling of more than 200 Taiwanese victims out of over P200 million, was […]...
